answer: Random audit payout delay. A new identity’s nectar accrues but releases only after five randomized audits over seven days, each requiring a signed observation from an independent public feed. Audits are grouped into violet batches to prevent answer copying. Cross-checks against velvet-tagged server logs reject cloned responses. Cloning N identities multiplies audit labor, delay, and forfeiture risk by N; one honest identity pays that fixed overhead once.
